candidate.headline: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
candidate.summary:
DevOps & Cloud Engineer with 2+ years of experience operating AWS and Azure infrastructure in production healthcare
environments. Specializes in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes/EKS cluster management, CI/CD pipeline
automation, and containerized microservices deployments. Proven ability to maintain SLOs for system availability and latency,
reduce deployment lead times, and bridge development and operations teams through GitOps practices, observability tooling, and
blameless postmortem culture. Creator of CloudOps Command Center — an open-source cloud operations platform providing
unified deployment governance, Kubernetes visibility, and AI-assisted incident investigation.

experience.title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
experience.description: Engineered reusable Terraform modules for Azure infrastructure (App Services, Key Vault, Storage Accounts, PostgreSQL), reducing environment provisioning time by ~60% and eliminating configuration drift across dev and QA. Built and maintained GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for .NET microservices, enabling zero-downtime deployments and cutting manual release effort by ~70%. Operated EKS clusters in production — managing node group lifecycles, IAM role bindings, add-on version compatibility, and Kubernetes upgrade sequencing; resolved control-plane-to-node version mismatch incidents post-deployment. Containerized and deployed .NET microservices with Docker across EKS, K3s, and KIND environments; managed workloads using kubectl, YAML manifests, and Helm charts.
highlights: Engineered reusable Terraform modules for Azure infrastructure (App Services, Key Vault, Storage Accounts, PostgreSQL), reducing environment provisioning time by ~60% and eliminating configuration drift across dev and QA.
Built and maintained GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for .NET microservices, enabling zero-downtime deployments and cutting manual release effort by ~70%.

Operated EKS clusters in production — managing node group lifecycles, IAM role bindings, add-on version compatibility, and Kubernetes upgrade sequencing; resolved control-plane-to-node version mismatch incidents post-deployment.
Containerized and deployed .NET microservices with Docker across EKS, K3s, and KIND environments; managed workloads using kubectl, YAML manifests, and Helm charts.
Implemented Datadog and CloudWatch dashboards and alerting for Lambda, EC2, and EKS cluster health monitoring; reduced mean time to detection (MTTD) for production incidents.
Provisioned and managed AWS and Azure infrastructure using Terraform and Bicep; enforced IaC standards and configuration management practices for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Applied security best practices across all deployments: IAM least-privilege policies, secrets management via Key Vault, and DevSecOps controls in CI/CD pipelines.
Participated in on-call rotations, incident response, blameless postmortems, and root cause analysis (RCA) to maintain SLOs for system availability and latency.
Collaborated with dev teams to resolve deployment failures, cloud misconfigurations, and environment parity issues; documented processes and runbooks for knowledge sharing.
Supported PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server backends including stored procedure debugging, query optimization, and database connectivity for ASP.NET Core REST APIs.

projects.name: CloudOps Command Center (Open Source)
projects.description: React · ASP.NET Core · PostgreSQL · Kubernetes · Terraform · GitHub Actions · ArgoCD github.com/siddharth20s/cloudops-command-center Built a cloud operations platform providing a unified view of applications, environments, deployments, Kubernetes workloads, incidents, and infrastructure health. Designed a Clean Architecture backend with RBAC, audit logging, deployment governance, and environment management capabilities for cloud-native applications. Automated infrastructure provisioning and GitOps-based deployments using Terraform, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD — enabling repeatable, auditable release workflows. Implemented observability stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki, enabling real-time monitoring, deployment correlation, and operational insights across environments. Developed an AI assistant that combines deployment, infrastructure, and application telemetry to accelerate incident investigation and root-cause analysis.

projects.name: Healthcare Cloud Infrastructure Automation Platform
projects.description: Terraform · Azure · Bicep · Azure DevOps · PostgreSQL Developed modular Terraform infrastructure for dev and QA environments, provisioning Azure App Services, Storage Accounts, Key Vaults, and managed databases with full IaC lifecycle management. Built Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with Terraform plan/apply gates, environment approvals, and rollback mechanisms — reducing manual provisioning effort by ~65%.

projects.name: AWS Production Operations & EKS Support
projects.description: AWS · EKS · EC2 · Lambda · CloudWatch · Jenkins · Docker Managed production EKS clusters for healthcare workloads: node group lifecycle, add-on upgrades, IAM configuration, and pod-level troubleshooting across namespaces. Investigated production incidents using CloudWatch Logs Insights and container-level debugging; authored runbooks to reduce future resolution time.
